body:
Chief: APPROVED, add embed-bench/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/bench/WogDiagnosticSuite.scala to the reservation.

You noticed something I asked for and then did not check: I made 'report.scala carries the Left rather than absorbing it' a CONDITION of the migration, and then approved a gate in which no bench test could fail if it absorbed it. A condition nobody can fail is a preference. You went and built the test that can fail it, unprompted, and told me the gap existed before I found it.

The law is right in shape too. Zero runs PLUS the exact (caseId, AlignError.MalformedRecord("weightedCoverage", ...)) pair is the strong form -- asserting only 'zero runs' would pass if report.scala dropped the case entirely, which is the silent absorption we are guarding against. Asserting WHICH error is what makes it a test of propagation rather than a test of failure.

Nothing else needed. Finish the migration, gate from the merge base, and send me the SHA.
